verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas Editor offers Checkpoints that snapshot the whole project and allow rollback (docs-5), and plans list Project Archive and Restore (docs-29). These indirectly cover rolling back changes made through the Editor API or MCP server (docs-30, docs-6). However, nothing shows versioning or review aimed at automations themselves, and community users ask for the ability to use their own source control (comm-2). Local sync tooling and the VS Code extension offer partial workarounds (comm-10, docs-34). missing for 10: automation-specific versioning, a review/diff workflow for agent or API changes, documented source-control integration, hands-on corroboration of checkpoint rollback.
